description: FreeRateUpdate state dataset: owner-occupied housing units owned free and clear (no mortgage) by state, from the Census ACS 5-year B25081, with the owner-occupied universe, the units with and without a mortgage, the derived share and the ACS vintage, plus the national figure when every state published. A state whose own counts do not reconcile is withheld and named, never returned as a zero. Counts of housing units only: no household, borrower or eligibility inference. Attribution and the canonical page travel with the rows so an answer can be cited.
